text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
We did it!
Now we can build another new bath♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Our inn can look forward to even greater prosperity! The whole hot spring town will be flourishing~!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, you've really gotten the hang of the excavation work.
You'll probably be even faster next time.
Keep up the good work!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Hot spring excavation successful!
Let's keep digging to find the next spring source!"
